log.description: Log file being written, if recording.

authenticated.description: The request carries a valid session.

configured.description: A password exists (configured or set on the setup screen).

csrf_token.description:
CSRF token to send as `X-CSRF-Token` on POST / PUT / DELETE (also in the
`wpg_csrf` cookie); `null` when not logged in.

setup_required.description: No password yet: show the setup screen (`POST /api/auth/setup`).

available.description: Compiled in and supported on this OS (privileges not checked).

default.description: Backend used when a job names none.

CaptureInfo.description: A capture as returned by the API.

saved.description:
Whether a pcapng file was written (download with
`GET /api/captures/{id}/pcapng`).

CaptureSpec.description: What to capture (all fields are optional).

count.description: Stop after this many matching frames.

filter.description: tcpdump-style filter (`udp port 5001 and wpg`); empty = every frame.

iface.description:
Interface (`any` = every interface with `afpacket`); for `pcapfile` the
name of a capture file under `<data_dir>/captures` (e.g. a dry-run output).

include_outgoing.description: Also count frames this host transmits.

keep.description: Matching frames kept for display (default 100, at most 10000).

save.description:
Save the matching frames as a pcapng file of this name under
`<data_dir>/captures`.

verify.description: Check the signatures of matching frames (loss / order / latency).

hex.description: Captured octets as lower-case hex (decode with `POST /api/parse`).

ts_ns.description: Capture time, nanoseconds since the Unix epoch.

oneOf.description: Selects the jobs whose `stats` / `job_state` events are sent.

jobs.description: `"all"` or a list of job ids.

start.description: Start immediately (default `true`); `false` leaves it in state `created`.

ErrorBody.description: `{ "error": ... }` body (OpenAPI schema of every error response).

details.description: Extra data, e.g. the lint issues of an invalid template.

message.description: Human readable message in the language of `Accept-Language`.

pos.description: Byte offset of the error (when invalid).

JobBrief.description: A running job on the dashboard.

JobInfo.description: A job as returned by the API (also the persisted history record).

name.description: Display name (`spec.name`, else the first template's name).

JobSpec.description: What to send, where and how (all fields but `streams` are optional).

count.description: Total packets (default: the template's `tx.count` for a single stream).

dry_run.description:
Dry run: write a pcapng file of this name under `<data_dir>/captures`
instead of sending (forces the `pcapfile` backend).

iface.description: Interface (not needed for `null`; the output file name for `pcapfile`).

rate.description:
Rate: `1000pps`, `1Mpps`, `10Gbps`, `50%`, `ifg=10us`, `unlimited`
(default: the first template's `tx.rate`, then `tx.max_rate`, else unlimited).

signature.description:
Stamp every frame with a receive-verification signature (magic + stream
id + sequence number + TX time over the last 24 payload octets; see
`/api/captures` with `verify`).

stream_id.description:
Signature stream id of the first stream (stream `i` gets `stream_id + i`;
default 0).

streams.description: Streams (at least one). Several streams are mixed into one TX worker.

oneOf.description: Created with `start: false`, not started yet.

JobStream.description: One stream of a job: a stored template (`template_id`) or an inline one.

JobTotals.description: Dashboard aggregate of the running jobs.

active.description: Jobs that are scheduled, running or paused.

bps.description: Sum of the jobs' L2 bits per second.

l1_bps.description: Sum of the jobs' L1 bits per second.

pps.description: Sum of the jobs' packets per second.

comment.description: The entry's comment (who accepted it and when).

host.description: Host as typed by the user who accepted the key (lower case).

LogInfo.description: A past or running session log (`GET /api/terminal/logs`).

active.description: Still being written by a live session.

bytes_hex.description: Frame bytes as hex (whitespace, `:` / `-` separators and `0x` allowed).

fcs.description: The frame ends with a 4-octet FCS.

diagnostics.description: Parse and build findings with localised `message`.

packet.description: Decoded packet (`wpg_core::Packet`: layers with Manual field values).

echo.description: Whether the answer may be shown while typed.

next.description: Protocols this one can carry (its next-layer binding table).

synth.description: Content generator instead of wire fields (payload).

index.description: Stream index of the first packet (default 0).

template.description: Template: object (JSON form of `.wpg.yaml`) or YAML text.

cardinality.description: Packets in the whole stream (`null` = unbounded).

plan.description: How a job would expand the stream (pre-render vs on-the-fly).

bytes_hex.description: Frame bytes as lower-case hex (without FCS unless the template asks for one).

Role.description: A user role (only `admin` is created for now; operator / viewer are P1).

ServerEvent.description: One message from the server to WebSocket clients.

oneOf.description: Latest statistics of a running job (every 100 ms, one per job).
The template index changed (file watcher or API write).

Latest statistics of a capture (every 100 ms while it runs, once more at
the end).

password.description: The new admin password (at least 8 characters).

TemplateDetail.description: A template with its index entry and lint findings.

recent.description: Recently used template ids, most recent first.

description.description:
Description in the requested language (`meta.descriptions[lang]`, else
`meta.description`, else `meta.descriptions.en`).

descriptions.description: All localised descriptions (language tag → text, e.g. `ja`, `en`).

error.description: Load error when the file does not parse.

id.description: Stable id (slug of the relative path).

last_used.description: Last use (open in the GUI, job start), Unix milliseconds.

name.description: `meta.name` (the file stem when the file does not parse).

path.description: Path relative to its root directory.

writable.description: Whether it can be updated / deleted through the API.

TerminalClientMessage.description:
Client → server message on `/api/terminal/ws`. Keystrokes may also arrive
as binary frames (raw bytes).

save.description: Store it in the known hosts (otherwise trust it for this session).

TerminalConnectRequest.description: `connect`: where to and how to log in.

password.description: SSH password (also answers a single keyboard-interactive password prompt).

strip_ansi.description: Remove escape sequences from the log (default true).

TerminalServerMessage.description:
Server → client message on `/api/terminal/ws`. Remote output travels as
binary frames.

oneOf.description: An unknown SSH host key: confirm the fingerprint (`host_key` message).

The server asks questions (keyboard-interactive, or the password when
none was given): answer with `auth_response`.
A failure; `fatal` ones are followed by `closed`.

api_version.description: REST API version (bumped on incompatible changes).

csrfToken.description: Required on POST / PUT / DELETE: the `csrf_token` of `GET /api/auth/status` (also the `wpg_csrf` cookie)
csrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token

info.description:
REST + WebSocket API of the wpg server. Errors are `{ "error": { "code", "message", "details" } }` with `message` in the language of `Accept-Language` (en, ja).

Authentication: log in with `POST /api/auth/login` (or complete `POST /api/auth/setup` on first run); the `wpg_session` cookie then authenticates every request and POST / PUT / DELETE must also send the session's CSRF token (cookie `wpg_csrf`, `GET /api/auth/status`) in `X-CSRF-Token`. Without a session protected endpoints answer 401 (`unauthorized`, or `setup_required` while no password exists).
info.title: wpg — Web Packet Generator API

post.summary:
Logs in (rate limited per client address: 5 failures a minute, then an
exponentially growing lock-out up to 15 minutes). Requires
`Content-Type: application/json`.

Logs out (needs `X-CSRF-Token` when the session is live) and clears the
cookies.

First-run setup: sets the admin password and logs in. Only while no
password is configured, and only from a loopback client unless the server
runs with `--allow-insecure`. Requires `Content-Type: application/json`.
